verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official RESTful Gmail API (endpoints, push notifications, scopes), but no item mentions official SDKs or client libraries. A raw REST API is a developer building block, not the SDK capability this story asks about, so it earns no credit. The probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt that might back generated SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Gmail API is a RESTful API that lets you access Gmail mailboxes and send mail.
